title: Hexalith.Conversations Conformance Manifest Schema
description: Structured specification for the versioned release-specific conformance manifest. Each entry maps one conformance test to a functional or non-functional requirement, carry-forward commitment, release-gate status, pass criteria, waiver status, measurement method, environment, and evidence artifact. This document is navigable by non-developer release approvers without requiring log or system access.

fields.name: testId
fields.description: Stable bounded machine-readable identifier for the conformance test. Must use only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, underscores, and dots. Maximum 128 characters.

fields.name: testName
fields.description: Bounded human-readable name for the test. Maximum 512 characters. No control characters or protected identifiers.

fields.name: requirementId
fields.description: The functional or non-functional requirement identifier this test verifies (e.g., FR83, NFR63). Must be a bounded machine-readable token.

fields.name: carryForwardCommitmentRef
fields.description: Optional bounded reference to a carry-forward commitment this test satisfies. Null when not applicable.

fields.name: releaseGateId
fields.description: Optional release gate this test contributes to. One of: tenant-isolation, audit-integrity, redaction-non-leakage, unsupported-schema-rejection, projection-rebuild-determinism, contract-compatibility, provider-portability. Null when the test is not gate-specific.

fields.name: passCriteria
fields.description: Bounded human-readable description of what constitutes a passing result for this test. Maximum 512 characters.

fields.name: releaseDecisionStatus
fields.description: Current release decision for this test entry. One of: pass, fail, waived, unknown-accepted. When waived, waiverReference must be present (enforced by validation).

fields.name: waiverReference
fields.validation: optional-safe-token; required-by-validator when releaseDecisionStatus is waived
fields.description: Optional bounded waiver reference. Must be present when releaseDecisionStatus is waived; ValidateManifest returns missing-waiver-reference otherwise.

fields.name: measurementMethod
fields.description: Bounded description of how this test result is measured or produced (e.g., automated-doc-validation-test, automated-generation-test).

fields.name: environment
fields.description: Bounded descriptor of the environment in which the test was executed (e.g., local-ci, staging-env).

fields.name: evidenceArtifactHandle
fields.description: Bounded machine-readable handle for the evidence artifact that supports this test entry.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Bounded identifier for the owner responsible for this test entry and its evidence.

fields.name: lifecycleStage
fields.description: The lifecycle stage of the conformance activity. One of: design-review, automated-test, load-performance-test, operational-drill, release-evidence, accessibility-validation.

fields.name: registeredAtUtc
fields.description: UTC timestamp when this test entry was registered in the manifest. Offset must be zero.

validationRules.description: Each testId must appear at most once in the manifest entries. Duplicate testId values indicate either a data entry error or a missing versioned entry.
When releaseDecisionStatus is waived, the waiverReference field must be non-null. An entry claiming waived status without a waiver reference is incomplete and cannot be accepted.

exampleRow.testName: Contract compatibility policy document publication and validation
exampleRow.passCriteria: Policy document exists and validation tests pass
